Title: Organization roles whitelist filters the org-level 'Change roles' select2 picker (CONFIRMED WORKING -- verify via removal, not addition)
Section: Org Roles > Organization Whitelist > Dropdown Filter
Preconditions: Admin logged into {{BACK_URL}}. VCST-5239 (customer#304) ships Customer|Roles settings Customer.OrganizationRolesWhitelist / Customer.MembershipRolesWhitelist (ValueType=ShortText, IsDictionary=true; whitelist content lives in allowedValues, NOT value). Whitelist entries are SELECTED from the live platform roles list (GET /api/platform/security/roles/search) -- never free-text dictionary entry. VERIFIED LIVE (2026-07-09, live re-verification corrected a stale earlier read): the org-level 'Change roles' role picker DOES filter by the Organization whitelist. Picker options = (assignable roles INTERSECT whitelist) MINUS roles already assigned to that org -- so testing by ADDING a whitelisted role to an org with none yet assigned looks unfiltered (nothing to subtract) and is further confounded by the VCST-5441 clear-persist bug (ORGROLE-005). The CORRECT falsification is to REMOVE a role that is CURRENTLY VISIBLE in the picker from the whitelist and confirm it disappears. The picker is a select2 control -- open and read it via CDP (Chrome DevTools MCP); a synthetic click that never dispatches a real pointer event into the select2 search area will fail to open the dropdown and produce a false 'unfiltered/all roles' read (this is what produced the earlier incorrect DRAFT/FAIL status on this case). Settings changes require a cache-reset + full page reload (ignoreCache navigation, not an in-SPA route change) before the picker reflects them. A throwaway AGENT-TEST organization is created in Steps so the shared TechFlow/BuildRight fixtures are never touched.

Title: Organization whitelist EMPTY = no restriction -- picker shows ALL platform roles (by design, source-grounded)
Section: Org Roles > Organization Whitelist > Adversarial
Preconditions: Admin logged into {{BACK_URL}}. EXPECTATION CORRECTED 2026-07-15 (was: empty whitelist must lock out to zero options -- that assumption came from ba-report-2026-07-09.md Open Question #2 and was NEVER source-verified). SOURCE OF TRUTH: vc-module-customer Scripts/services/rolesPickerService.js applies the whitelist filter ONLY inside `if (whitelist.length) { ...filter... }` -- when the whitelist is EMPTY the filter block is skipped and the full roles list is returned. So an empty Organization whitelist means NO RESTRICTION -> the org-level 'Roles' picker (organization-detail.js, whitelistSettingId 'Customer.OrganizationRolesWhitelist') offers ALL platform roles. This is BY DESIGN, not a fallback bug. Confirmed live 2026-07-15 during VCST-5441 verification (Platform 3.1044.0-pr-3076-3479): empty whitelist -> all ~42 roles; a 2-entry whitelist -> picker narrows to exactly those (ORGROLE-001/002). ORGROLE-001/002 already prove the filter IS active when the whitelist is non-empty, so this case only pins the empty = no-restriction direction as a regression guard. Use CDP (not a synthetic click) to open the select2 picker, and a cache-reset + full page reload after writing the empty whitelist, per the interaction-method correction in ORGROLE-001. Throwaway AGENT-TEST organization created in Steps. SCOPE NOTE (BL-B2B-011, amended 2026-09-19): this case exercises the GLOBAL tenant scope only, via the legacy v1 `/api/platform/settings` surface where the selected whitelist set is read/written through `allowedValues` -- on that surface empty-whitelist-means-all-roles is fully determined, not a coincidence of environment state. It does NOT generalize to STORE tenant scope: at STORE scope an empty override is skipped and the picker falls through to whatever the GLOBAL whitelist currently holds -- a second hop that only reads as 'all roles' because GLOBAL happens to be empty here (see ORGROLE-020, which reads the GLOBAL value live rather than assuming it).

On vcst this reads as 'all roles' only because GLOBAL happens to be empty ([]) at rest (see ORGROLE-018's SCOPE NOTE); a deployment with a non-empty GLOBAL whitelist would narrow instead. Per BL-B2B-011's own Violation signal, a case that asserts 'empty STORE ⇒ all roles' without independently confirming GLOBAL is also empty records a coincidence, not the mechanism -- this case therefore WRITES GLOBAL to a KNOWN, deliberately non-empty control set and READS IT BACK live in the same run (EXPECTED_GLOBAL) rather than assuming any ambient state, then asserts the picker against that captured value. Source of truth: same v1/v2 field-inversion mechanism as ORGROLE-019 -- see that case's Preconditions. REFRESH REQUIREMENT: Settings -> Reset cache + full page reload after every write.
